description: default layout with the Cmd+P palette open on step 1 (type), dark. The list holds two rows in order: Browser (globe icon, the browser's own 16x16 SVG), then Stub (the harness stub type, icon the text glyph U+25A3 in a span); the browser row is first, so row 0 (Browser, badge 1) is highlighted and row 1 (Stub, badge 2) is not.
